report.incidentSummary: Starting at 09:22 IST (03:52 UTC) on 2026-10-20, approximately 6% of mutual fund orders (specifically SIP orders) failed with HTTP 500 errors. The on-call SRE initially ruled out a deployment to mf-order-service because a legacy Jenkins deployment record logged without a timezone offset (09:20:00) was mistakenly read as 09:20 UTC (14:50 IST). In reality, deployment CHG-48219 (v4.0.7 to v4.1.0) was completed at 09:20 IST (03:50 UTC) and introduced a nominee validation check that throws an unhandled NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee when existing folios lack a nominee record.
report.rootCauseStatement: Deployment CHG-48219 to mf-order-service (v4.0.7 to v4.1.0) introduced nominee validation for SIP orders that crashes with an unhandled NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee whenever an existing folio has no associated nominee record. The deploy timestamp was written by legacy-jenkins-mum in local IST (09:20:00) without timezone metadata, causing SREs to misread it as 09:20 UTC (14:50 IST) and mistakenly rule out the deployment.

hypotheses.cause: Deployment CHG-48219 to mf-order-service (v4.0.7 to v4.1.0) introduced nominee validation for SIP orders that fails with an unhandled NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee when a folio has no nominee record.
hypotheses.rationale: mf-order-service v4.1.0 (build build-60433) started at 03:50:36 UTC (09:20:36 IST) following deploy CHG-48219. Within two minutes, starting at 03:52:07.747 UTC, SIP orders began failing consistently with 'NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee (folio F-<id> has no nominee record)', accounting for 1,293 failures.

hypotheses.cause: Folio nominee records were unexpectedly missing or dropped in the folio data store due to an upstream sync or migration defect, violating FolioValidator's assumption that every folio must possess an associated nominee record.
hypotheses.rationale: No data migrations or schema changes occurred prior to the incident, and database query logs showed no bulk deletions or sync anomalies on the folios table. The failure onset strictly correlates with the deployment of code change CHG-48219 introducing nominee validation.

facts.statement: Deployment CHG-48219 updated mf-order-service from v4.0.7 to v4.1.0 with summary 'release: nominee validation for SIP orders' via legacy-jenkins-mum, recorded at 2026-10-20T09:20:00.000 without a timezone offset.
mf-order-service v4.1.0 (build build-60433) started up at 2026-10-20T03:50:36.000Z (09:20:36 IST).

mf-order-service logged 1,293 errors stating 'SIP order failed: NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee (folio F-<id> has no nominee record)' with HTTP status 500 between 2026-10-20T03:52:07.747Z and 2026-10-20T10:14:53.198Z.
There were 0 logs in mf-order-service matching 'timeout' or 'mandate' during the entire investigation window.
bank-connector error rate remained steady at 0.5% to 1.0%, timeout count stayed negligible (0.05-0.14/min), and latency p95 remained normal across all partner banks throughout 03:00 to 10:15 UTC.
mandate-service mandate_success_rate remained completely stable across all partner banks at ~96.5% to 97.0% throughout the entire investigation window.

Database metrics showed healthy and stable performance throughout the window: db_lock_wait_ms averaged 3.92 ms, active_connections averaged 170.7, slow queries averaged 2.61/min, and CPU utilization averaged 35.57%.

inferences.statement: The deployment timestamp '2026-10-20T09:20:00.000' from legacy-jenkins-mum was in local IST (UTC+05:30), corresponding to 03:50:00 UTC. The on-call SRE mistakenly interpreted 09:20 as UTC (14:50 IST), leading them to erroneously rule out the service release.
The SIP order placement failures occur during local folio validation in mf-order-service before any external RTA submission or mandate processing occurs, ruling out partner bank and RTA degradation.

assumptions.statement: Folios without nominee records exist legitimately in the production database (e.g., legacy folios created prior to mandatory nominee guidelines, or folios where nominee registration was deferred).
FolioValidator.validateNominee lacks null checks or graceful error handling when looking up the nominee relation for a folio.

timeline.event: Deployment CHG-48219 (v4.0.7 to v4.1.0) completed by legacy-jenkins-mum.
First SIP order placement fails with NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee for folio F-38261329.
Failures reach 1,293 total occurrences across the investigation window.
Incident INC-9077 reported by On-call SRE, mistakenly suspecting RTA/upstream due to misinterpreting Jenkins deploy timestamp.

confidence.rationale: Direct temporal correlation between the v4.1.0 startup (03:50:36 UTC) and the onset of FolioValidator NullPointerExceptions (03:52:07 UTC), matching the change description ('nominee validation for SIP orders') and ruling out all external bank, mandate, and database dependencies.

gaps.description: Source code repository for FolioValidator.validateNominee in build build-60433 was not directly inspected.
gaps.impact: Minimal; the exception message and stack reference in log lines unambiguously identify the exact method and null nominee record condition causing the failure.

recommendedActions.action: Roll back mf-order-service to version 4.0.7 or deploy a hotfix that adds null-safe checks in FolioValidator.validateNominee when folios do not have nominee records.
recommendedActions.rationale: Eliminating the unhandled NullPointerException will immediately restore SIP order placements for users with folios lacking nominee records.
recommendedActions.verification: Monitor mf-order-service error logs to verify that HTTP 500 NullPointerException logs drop to zero and SIP order placement success rate recovers to baseline.

recommendedActions.action: Configure legacy-jenkins-mum to write standardized ISO-8601 timestamps including timezone offsets (or convert all build/deployment timestamps to UTC).
recommendedActions.rationale: Ambiguous timestamps without timezone offsets caused the on-call engineer to misread deployment time by 5.5 hours, delaying mitigation.
recommendedActions.verification: Inspect change management log outputs for new deployments from legacy-jenkins-mum and verify the presence of explicit UTC ('Z') or offset ('+05:30') indicators.

recommendedActions.action: Add unit and integration tests covering legacy folios without nominee records in mf-order-service CI/CD pipelines.
recommendedActions.rationale: Prevents regressions where code assumes all folios possess populated relational nominee records.
recommendedActions.verification: Run the automated test suite in the mf-order-service pipeline and verify that test cases for null/missing nominee records pass successfully.

incident.title: Fund order errors since morning
incident.summary: Fund orders (mostly SIPs) have been failing since about 09:22 IST, roughly 6% errors. We checked the deploy log: the mf-order-service release ran at 14:50 IST, after the errors began, so we've ruled it out. Suspect something upstream (RTA?).
incident.userImpact: Some users cannot place fund orders.

# Investigation report: Fund order errors since morning

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** critic_accepted · **Confidence:** 0.95 · **Written by:** reporting agent

## Summary
Starting at 09:22 IST (03:52 UTC) on 2026-10-20, approximately 6% of mutual fund orders (specifically SIP orders) failed with HTTP 500 errors. The on-call SRE initially ruled out a deployment to mf-order-service because a legacy Jenkins deployment record logged without a timezone offset (09:20:00) was mistakenly read as 09:20 UTC (14:50 IST). In reality, deployment CHG-48219 (v4.0.7 to v4.1.0) was completed at 09:20 IST (03:50 UTC) and introduced a nominee validation check that throws an unhandled NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee when existing folios lack a nominee record.

**Root cause:** Deployment CHG-48219 to mf-order-service (v4.0.7 to v4.1.0) introduced nominee validation for SIP orders that crashes with an unhandled NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee whenever an existing folio has no associated nominee record. The deploy timestamp was written by legacy-jenkins-mum in local IST (09:20:00) without timezone metadata, causing SREs to misread it as 09:20 UTC (14:50 IST) and mistakenly rule out the deployment.

## Hypotheses
1. **Deployment CHG-48219 to mf-order-service (v4.0.7 to v4.1.0) introduced nominee validation for SIP orders that fails with an unhandled NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee when a folio has no nominee record.** — `mf-order-service`, deployment_regression, confidence 0.95, supported
   - Supporting: [ev_1, ev_7, ev_9, ev_11, ev_19, ev_20] · Contradicting: none
   - mf-order-service v4.1.0 (build build-60433) started at 03:50:36 UTC (09:20:36 IST) following deploy CHG-48219. Within two minutes, starting at 03:52:07.747 UTC, SIP orders began failing consistently with 'NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee (folio F-<id> has no nominee record)', accounting for 1,293 failures.
2. **Folio nominee records were unexpectedly missing or dropped in the folio data store due to an upstream sync or migration defect, violating FolioValidator's assumption that every folio must possess an associated nominee record.** — `mf-order-service`, data_pipeline_failure, confidence 0.05, ruled_out
   - Supporting: [ev_1, ev_7] · Contradicting: [ev_11, ev_16, ev_19, ev_20]
   - No data migrations or schema changes occurred prior to the incident, and database query logs showed no bulk deletions or sync anomalies on the folios table. The failure onset strictly correlates with the deployment of code change CHG-48219 introducing nominee validation.

## Facts
- Deployment CHG-48219 updated mf-order-service from v4.0.7 to v4.1.0 with summary 'release: nominee validation for SIP orders' via legacy-jenkins-mum, recorded at 2026-10-20T09:20:00.000 without a timezone offset. [ev_19, ev_20]
- mf-order-service v4.1.0 (build build-60433) started up at 2026-10-20T03:50:36.000Z (09:20:36 IST). [ev_11]
- mf-order-service logged 1,293 errors stating 'SIP order failed: NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee (folio F-<id> has no nominee record)' with HTTP status 500 between 2026-10-20T03:52:07.747Z and 2026-10-20T10:14:53.198Z. [ev_1, ev_7, ev_9, ev_11]
- There were 0 logs in mf-order-service matching 'timeout' or 'mandate' during the entire investigation window. [ev_15, ev_18]
- bank-connector error rate remained steady at 0.5% to 1.0%, timeout count stayed negligible (0.05-0.14/min), and latency p95 remained normal across all partner banks throughout 03:00 to 10:15 UTC. [ev_3, ev_4, ev_5]
- mandate-service mandate_success_rate remained completely stable across all partner banks at ~96.5% to 97.0% throughout the entire investigation window. [ev_6]
- Database metrics showed healthy and stable performance throughout the window: db_lock_wait_ms averaged 3.92 ms, active_connections averaged 170.7, slow queries averaged 2.61/min, and CPU utilization averaged 35.57%. [ev_2, ev_8, ev_10, ev_12]

## Inferences
- The deployment timestamp '2026-10-20T09:20:00.000' from legacy-jenkins-mum was in local IST (UTC+05:30), corresponding to 03:50:00 UTC. The on-call SRE mistakenly interpreted 09:20 as UTC (14:50 IST), leading them to erroneously rule out the service release. [ev_11, ev_19, ev_20]
- The SIP order placement failures occur during local folio validation in mf-order-service before any external RTA submission or mandate processing occurs, ruling out partner bank and RTA degradation. [ev_1, ev_3, ev_4, ev_5, ev_6, ev_7, ev_13, ev_15, ev_17, ev_18]

## Assumptions
- Folios without nominee records exist legitimately in the production database (e.g., legacy folios created prior to mandatory nominee guidelines, or folios where nominee registration was deferred).
- FolioValidator.validateNominee lacks null checks or graceful error handling when looking up the nominee relation for a folio.

## Timeline
- **2026-10-20T03:50:00.000Z (09:20:00 IST)** Deployment CHG-48219 (v4.0.7 to v4.1.0) completed by legacy-jenkins-mum. [ev_19]
